'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Chris Menzel LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Chris Menzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]] <small>(inferred: no Objective; Throne Room Mains start)</small>
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/worlds-2014-reset-beta-event-chris-menzel-ls-trm/ PC list]
